author: /root/stage05_g3_contract
exception_reuse_scope: Inventory entries are unique per original source path plus exact JSON pointer. The same source file may appear under multiple distinct canonical archive paths; re-scanning that exact original file uses the same pinned exception identity. All listed exception identities must be consumed at least once; unused and duplicate inventory entries refuse. No per-invocation once-only claim is made.

inventory.containing_object_sha256: SHA256 of canonical JSON for the containing original dictionary.
inventory.json_pointer: RFC6901 pointer to the exact subject field in the complete original JSON document.
inventory.requires: Closed actual ORDINARY_V02 evidence, exact source file hashes and independent packaging review.
inventory.subject_sha256: SHA256 of canonical JSON for the subject value.

security_properties: No general subject exemption, publisher change, source schema change, witness omission, extension renaming or raw-byte rewriting.
Only two finite V02 copied public evidence prefixes are eligible; file SHA256 and size, exact pointer, subject hash and containing object hash are required.

Existing publisher scans a validation-only copy after explicitly bound public subject fields are omitted from that view. Every omitted value is recursively scanned separately. Original payload bytes are unchanged.
All other secret keys remain rejected. Duplicate inventory entries and unused entries refuse before publisher reservation. The inventory itself is archived.
Repeated copies of the same exact source under different archive names do not authorize new exceptions; the exception identity remains original source path plus exact pointer.
v02_tightenings: Archive paths must be strings, nonempty, not dot, and equal their canonical POSIX form; existing absolute, forbidden, reserved and duplicate archive-name refusal remains.
Typed G3 local Root is exactly root:radik:experience: plus24lowerhex; extra root segments are refused.
